text:
- Total revenue across all countries reached £154.7k TW, representing a 6.6% increase WoW from £145.0k LW.
- United Kingdom dominated with £143.7k revenue TW, accounting for 92.9% of total sales and growing 10.1% WoW.
- Channel Islands generated £3.4k revenue TW with a market share of 2.2%, showing exceptional growth of 334.5% WoW.
- United Kingdom processed 382 orders TW from 96,600 units sold, significantly outpacing other markets.
- EIRE contributed £1.9k revenue TW with a 1.2% market share, representing the third-largest country by revenue.
- Netherlands recorded 1,263 units sold TW, while Channel Islands achieved 1,673 units from just 3 orders.
- France demonstrated strong momentum with revenue growth of 349.8% WoW, though absolute values remain modest.
- Total order volume reached 397 orders TW, with United Kingdom accounting for 96.2% of all orders processed.
